title: Enabling spatial intelligence in the AEC lifecycle: a framework and review of large language models
title_zh: 在建筑、工程与施工生命周期中实现空间智能：大型语言模型的框架与综述
abstract: Abstract The Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry is undergoing a profound digital transformation driven by the urgent need to integrate fragmented, heterogeneous data into actionable intelligence. This paper provides a systematic review of 76 representative studies to examine how Large Language Models (LLMs) enable spatial intelligence across the entire building lifecycle. A layered spatial intelligence framework is proposed, encompassing the dimensions of design, construction, operation, as well as research and education. The review demonstrates that LLMs are evolving from passive text processors into active cognitive partners capable of semantic interpretation, spatial reasoning, and complex decision-making. Key findings highlight the effectiveness of LLMs in requirement translation, multimodal design generation, regulatory compliance, and lifecycle Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration. Despite these advancements, significant challenges persist regarding spatial reasoning accuracy, the lack of physical embodiment, and institutional data governance. This research outlines a strategic roadmap toward embodied intelligence, AEC-specific world models, and enhanced human-AI collaboration, providing a structured foundation for the advancement of LLM-driven spatial intelligence in professional practice.
abstract_zh: 摘要：建筑、工程与施工（AEC）行业正经历深刻的数字化转型，迫切需要将碎片化、异构的数据整合为可操作的情报。本文系统回顾了76项代表性研究，探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）如何在整个建筑生命周期中实现空间智能。提出了一个分层空间智能框架，涵盖设计、施工、运营以及研究与教育等维度。综述显示，LLMs正从被动文本处理器演变为具备语义解释、空间推理和复杂决策能力的主动认知伙伴。主要发现强调了LLMs在需求翻译、多模态设计生成、法规合规和生命周期建筑信息模型（BIM）集成方面的有效性。尽管取得了这些进展，但在空间推理准确性、缺乏物理具身以及机构数据治理等方面仍面临重大挑战。本文概述了迈向具身智能、AEC专属世界模型和增强人机协作的战略路线图，为专业实践中基于LLM的空间智能发展提供了结构化基础。
